inspiration.observed_pattern: MICROSECOND extracts fractional-second precision from quoted temporal values and numeric datetime forms.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored TIME(6) column containing an exact-second value, preserving the fractional-time wire-format and MICROSECOND extraction contract.

fixture_notes: The single fixed TIME(6) value isolates MariaDB's preserved six-digit fractional-time representation when MICROSECOND is projected alongside it.
determinism_notes: The table and temporal literal are fixed; the query has no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE timing_ticks (tick_id INT PRIMARY KEY, elapsed TIME(6) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT elapsed, MICROSECOND(elapsed) AS elapsed_microseconds FROM timing_ticks ORDER BY tick_id
